pairs.rationale: primary CLM-EEG mediator-framing test; if |r| high, CLM internal tension co-modulates cortical alpha PLV
tension-bridge -> EEG link test; per-channel Pearson r computed, aggregate = max(|r|) over 5 channels
internal CLM consistency check; expected near-1 for active branch (fixed-point std~1e-6 known per #103 C3-5)

cross_pair_aggregation.per_pair_aggregate: median |r| over 6 phases, weighted by per-phase sample retention
cross_pair_aggregation.exclude_pair_C_from_binding_if_fixed_poi: if pair_C |r|>0.95 AND CLM std<1e-5, treat as trivial fixed-point and re-run binding_strength = mean(pair_A, pair_B) only

phase_specific_diagnostics.P3_vs_P4_test: key diagnostic per #103 — |r_P3| > |r_P4| with P3 PASS AND P4 FAIL = CLM-specific not generic-cognitive-load
phase_specific_diagnostics.interpretation: if P3-P4 < 0.15, binding is generic cognitive-load not CLM-specific
